tasks.title: Hazards exist as one shared, testable description: a registry every ship and enemy can query for pull, slow and danger
tasks.description: Build `global/hazards/`: `HazardInfo` (RefCounted; the seven IDEAS fields plus kind, core_radius, damage_radius, signed tangential_force, avoid_weight, velocity, source, claimer_id; falloff / accel_at / penalty_at / contains; claims try_claim / release / is_claimed_by / is_claimed stored as an instance id so a freed claimer frees the claim), the static `Hazards` registry (register / unregister / count / around / accel_at / penalty_at with MAX_PENALTY 0.5 strongest-only / container / hurt_box_of / pulse_damage by centre distance), `HazardDrift` (decaying drift, half-life 0.35 s) and `HazardField` (the one Node2D field script: exports, pulse cycle TELEGRAPH -> ACTIVE -> QUIET, duration, hull-stress pulses through pulse_damage, phase_changed / stressed signals, deferred `spawn_into(container, at, rot)` with `_attach.call_deferred` on itself, the ContactBlast pattern). No physics layer is allocated (bit 12 stays free). Plan §2.1.
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: Every row of plan §2.1 Tests passes in `tests/unit/test_hazards.gd` and `tests/unit/test_hazard_field.gd`, including the boundaries: falloff 0 at radius and finite with zero direction at r = 0; around() includes radius + reach and excludes 1 px beyond; strongest-only penalty (0.4 and 0.3 -> 0.4) and cap (0.8 -> 0.5); pulse_damage hits at exactly radius and not at radius + 1; a freed claimer frees the claim; count() is 0 after the node is freed; spawn_into frees itself when the container was freed first; a duck-typed fixture hazard joins around(). `scripts/check-test-leaks.sh` clean; `bash /agent/verify.sh` green; gate time before / after reported (allowance +0.5 s).

tasks.title: Enemies caught in a hazard are really pulled and slowed, by an amount set per ship type, while nothing changes where there is no hazard
tasks.description: Extend `global/enemy_ai/enemy_mover.gd` step order: slow factor (boost included) -> no-op hook for the avoidance stage -> accel limit on `own_velocity()` -> drift added only when non-zero (also while boosting) -> corridor filter last -> write; facing from v - drift when drift is non-zero. Add `own_velocity()` (used by `_vel()`), drift reset in `halt()`, the O(1) early-out on `Hazards.count() == 0`. Add `hazard_avoidance` / `hazard_margin` / `hazard_resistance` to the mover and to `ShipConfig` (export group Hazards), copied in `BaseEnemy._ready()`, with the per-enemy values of plan §2.2 in the nine `*_config.tres`. Switch the named brain 'settled / stopped' gates (Ram LINE_UP crawl, Sniper SETTLE, Fighter is_settled / is_braking_onto_station / RUN_IN standing start, Razor feint stop) from `actor.velocity` to `mover.own_velocity()`.
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: Plan §2.2 Tests pass in `tests/unit/test_enemy_mover.gd` and the new dual-mode rows of `tests/integration/test_enemy_dual_mode.gd`: bit-identical velocity and rotation with no hazard and with a fixture well 2000 px away for instant, accel-limited, boosting and Assault-constrained movers, including the -Vector2(200, 0) (-0.0) case; a Swarm config in the core cannot leave while a Fighter config can; drift persists through boost and halt() clears it; own_velocity() excludes the drift; a real Ram's LINE_UP inside a well ends on its line-up test, not at line_up_cap; the corridor still bounds a pulled enemy; a rail enemy is not moved. Every gate of plan §4.1 green unchanged (single-writer, config isolation, all Ph2-Ph5 rows). `bash /agent/verify.sh` green; gate time before / after and `test_fighter_squad.gd` time reported (allowance +1.5 s).

ShipTurnController stays the only rotation writer.
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: Plan §2.3 Tests pass in new `tests/integration/test_player_hazards.gd`: Open Space thrust escapes at 140 px but not at 100 px, boost escapes from 100 px, rotation unchanged; slow 0.6x on thrust and boost exit speed, and on Assault move and dash speed; an idle Assault fighter (only `_physics_process` called) drifts toward a well and stops at the x <= 1380 clamp; no drift during dialog or knockback; every existing `test_open_space_*` and player row unchanged. `bash /agent/verify.sh` green; gate time before / after (allowance +1 s).

tasks.title: Enemies steer round hazards with their own temperament - drones skim the edge, heavy ships keep clear - but charge straight through when committed to an attack
tasks.description: Add the pure `Steering.context_avoid()` in `global/enemy_ai/steering.gd` (16-slot interest / danger maps merged by max, profile threshold 1 - hazard_avoidance, masking, parabolic interpolation, previous-direction blend, minimum speed ratio 0.35) and call it from `EnemyMover.step()` at t2's hook, skipped while boosting. Infos come from `Hazards.around()`; a line-of-sight-blocking hazard claimed by the mover's own actor is dropped (the ship's own cover is its destination); wells are never skipped. Every mover-driven enemy avoids with its config profile; committed runs (boost) fly straight through and can be baited.
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: Plan §2.4 Tests pass in new `tests/unit/test_context_avoidance.gd` and dual-mode rows of `test_enemy_dual_mode.gd`: desired unchanged with no info or zero danger; target behind a well reached without entering radius and never below 35 % speed; inside -> first step outward; margin 12 skims closer than margin 90; avoidance 0.5 ignores a tangential pass that 1.0 bends round; boosting flies straight through; heading not quantised to 22.5 deg; a drifting hazard is led; a wreck claimed by the actor is ignored and one claimed by another node is avoided, and an arrive() to radius + 50 from the claimed wreck settles within 10 px (dual-mode); the Assault corridor still bounds the result; real-brain rows (Swarm skims, Fighter goes round, Swarm BURST captured). Every gate of plan §4.1 green unchanged, including the 168-layout squad sweep and every Ph2-Ph5 deadline / density / attack-in-budget row. `bash /agent/verify.sh` green; gate time before / after (allowance +3.5 s).

Enemy rounds stop on a wreck through the duck-typed `stops_enemy_rounds()` (EnemyBullet mask gains 1024; asteroids unchanged). Each scene has a `HAZARD.md` (including that a wreck blocks the player's beam and cannot be cut by it). Only a moving wreck hurts on contact.
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: Plan §2.8 Tests pass in new `tests/integration/test_wreck.gd` (8x clock where physics is needed): LOS blocked by a wreck and not by debris; player bullet, enemy rocket and enemy round stop on a wreck while a round still passes an asteroid; a drifting wreck hurts the player and an enemy, a stationary one touched by a moving player does not, and a wreck spawned on the player does not hurt it during its first 0.6 s; Assault drift 60 px/s down and free on leaving the world rect, Open Space free after lifetime; a wreck on the Assault player at the clamp edge never holds them more than 2 frames; retire() unregisters at once and frees after the fade; spawn_into on a freed container leaves no orphan; never in group enemies. tasks.title: Fighters wait out of sight behind a wreck before swooping in on their pass
